title: Kyun Chor Jaati Hai Maa
body:
Gir Chuka Dar Fatima Par
Ab Hai Zakhmi Muhammad Ki Beti
Haye Ik Din Sar Jhukaye
Apne Hujray Mein Bethi Hoi Thi Phir Hussain Aa Ke Amma Se Kehne Lagay
<<DIVIDER>>
Aankh Mein Kyun Hain Aanso Batao Mujhe
Fatima Ne Kaha Mere NooreNazar
Aaj Amma Ki Yaad Aa Rahi Hai Mujhe
Sun Ke Maa Ki Sada Dil Tarapney Laga
<<DIVIDER>>
Ro Ke Shabeer Ne Fatima Se Kaha Kyun Chor Jati Hai Maa
Ungli Pakar Ke Chalaya Seene Se Tum Ne Lagaya
Inn Teen Saloon Mein Amma Tum Ne Bohat Kuch Sikhaya
Maa Se Bichar Ke Jeetay Hain Kaisay Kya Yeh Sikhati Hai Maa Kyun Chor Jati Hai Maa
<<DIVIDER>>
Darwaza Jab Se Gira Hai Pehlu Shikasta Howa Hai
Totein Hoi Pasliyaan Hain Shabeer Sab Janta Hai
Takleef Mein Hoon Bachoon Ko Apne Kab Yeh Batati Hai Maa Kyun Chor Jati Hai Maa
Iss Fikar Mein Jaag Jana Pyasa Na Ho Mera Beta
<<DIVIDER>>
Ahsas Hai Mujh Ko Amma Kya Pyar Hota Hai Maa Ka
Raton Ko Uth Kar Betay Ko Apne Pani Pilati Hai Maa Kyun Chor Jati Hai Maa
Qissa Mujhe Aik Maa Ka Bhaiyya Hasan Ne Sunaya
Beta Wahin Samne Tha Jab Maa Ne Khaya Tamacha
<<DIVIDER>>
Ab Apne Ghar Mein Beton Se Apna Chehra Chupati Hai Maa Kyun Chor Jati Hai Maa
Jab Se Laga Taziyana Mushkil Tha Mujh Ko Sulana
Jab Hath Dekha Tumhara Tab Ja Ke Main Ne Yeh Jana
Hoon Hath Zakhmi Phir Bhi Thapak Kar Lori Sunati Hai Maa Kyun Chor Jati Hai Maa
<<DIVIDER>>
Shabeer Ne Phir Sada Di Kya Chor Jao Gi Tum Bhi
Kyun Aisa Kehti Ho Amma Rehti Nahi Maa Kissi Ki
Acha Batao Kya Door Ja Ke Phir Laut Aati Hai Maa Kyun Chor Jati Hai Maa
Maa Ne Kaha Phir Yeh Shabeer Se Har Maa Tu Aati Nahi Laut Ke
<<DIVIDER>>
Aye Mere Dil Mere NooreNazar Zahra Ka Ab Tum Se Wadah Hai Yeh
Jab Tum Bulao Gay Aaye Gi Maa Seene Se Tum Ko Lagaye Gi Maa Kyun Chor Jati Hai Maa
Ik Roz Aisa Bhi Aaya Tha Fatima Ka Janaza
Rukh Se Kafan Jab Hataya Shabeer Ne Maa Se Pocha
<<DIVIDER>>
ZaireKafan Bhi Aawaz Sun Kar Aanso Bahati Hai Maa Kyun Chor Jati Hai Maa
Bin Maa Ke Bachoon Se Aa Ke Jab Haal Pocha Ali Ne
Haye Raza Our Zeeshan Shabeer Ro Ro Ke Bolay
Aye Baba Ghar Mein Lagta Nahi Dil Jab Yaad Aati Hai Maa Kyun Chor Jati Hai Maa
